largeLegend.description: Whether to use the larger legend style (adds class `usa-legend--large`)

required.description: Whether to indicate the field is required (adds an asterisk to the legend)

disabled.description: Whether to disable all form controls within the fieldset

hint.description: Group-level hint text, rendered after the legend

error.description: Group-level error message, rendered after the hint

hintId.description: Element id for the hint span

errorId.description: Element id for the error message span
